method: solid-fraction probes on the authoritative B-rep
pressure_boundary: integral cabinet walls, acoustic floor and component mounting pads
compressed 2 mm EPDM divider gasket on a continuous 4 mm rim land
compressed 2 mm EPDM active-driver gasket on a continuous seat land
two compressed 2 mm EPDM radiator gaskets on continuous seat lands
TPU interference gland around the speaker-wire pair
all cabinet fasteners are blind heat-set inserts; none crosses the boundary

checks.feature: active_driver: gasket-land annulus continuity behind the seat
checks.note: A fraction below 1.0 means a radial path bypasses the component gasket and vents the chamber to ambient.

checks.feature: active_driver: seat sidewall is solid over the full seat depth
active_driver: clamp inserts are blind, backed by pad material
pr_-1: gasket-land annulus continuity behind the seat
checks.note: A fraction below 1.0 means a radial path bypasses the component gasket and vents the chamber to ambient.

checks.feature: pr_-1: seat sidewall is solid over the full seat depth
pr_-1: clamp inserts are blind, backed by pad material
pr_+1: gasket-land annulus continuity behind the seat
checks.note: A fraction below 1.0 means a radial path bypasses the component gasket and vents the chamber to ambient.

checks.feature: pr_+1: seat sidewall is solid over the full seat depth
pr_+1: clamp inserts are blind, backed by pad material
active_driver unused mounting holes are covered by the gasket
pr_-1 unused mounting holes are covered by the gasket
pr_+1 unused mounting holes are covered by the gasket
divider gasket land is a continuous closed rim
divider fastener inserts are blind inside the chamber
base-skirt inserts are blind below the acoustic floor

physical_gate.requirement: Use the temporary adapter for a 100-250 Pa gross leak screen with dilute soap solution, then confirm final sealing and tuning with an impedance sweep after installing the production cable gland.
